title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Cycle and Wine-Tasting Tour with Optional Lunch
includes: SMALL Cheese & Charcuterie Plate (Half-Day Tour Option)
Cruiser bicycle and helmet (REGULAR BICYCLE *NOT* ELECTRIC - YOU CAN UPGRADE TO ELECTRIC FOR $50)
Pickup and delivery of purchases back to HQ customers do not have to carry purchases on the bikes
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Travelers must be at least 19 years of age to consume alcohol
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the perfect blend of breathtaking landscapes and exquisite wines in our captivating biking and wine-tasting tour. Immerse yourself in the enchanting allure of Niagara-on-the-Lake, a picturesque town nestled along the shores of Lake Ontario, where you'll embark on a delightful journey of exploration and wine indulgence by bicycle. 

Choose between our Full Day 6-hour tour, an extensive adventure that takes you to three exceptional wineries and treats you to a delectable lunch at the renowned Caroline Cellars Winery. Alternatively, opt for our Half Day 4-hour tour, which also encompasses three esteemed wineries, accompanied by a SMALL Cheese & Charcuterie Pairing for a truly delectable experience. (for our Half Day Tour we recomend to have lunch prior and to bring extra snacks!)

As an added convenience, any wine you purchase during the tour will be promptly delivered back to our HQ for the end of the tour so you can relish the memories and flavours at your leisure.
